events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day, we reflect on the life and enduring legacy of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: A voice that defined a generation. Today we remember Tupac Shakur and his unparalleled impact on music and culture.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Still inspiring guitarists worldwide. Today, we pay tribute to the one and only Jimi Hendrix.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Which track is still on heavy rotation for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! A true original and rock icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad For It Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released in 1971, featuring his iconic title track.

angles.name: Imagine Album Message
angles.copy: More than just a song, it's a message. Remembering John Lennon's 'Imagine' album today.

events.title: The iPod: 25 Years of Portable Music
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years since the original iPod changed music forever. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th Birthday
events.blurb: On this day, we remember music icon John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Diversity
angles.copy: 58 years of the 'White Album'. So many styles, so many songs. Which track is your unexpected favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the incredible life and legacy of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Unforgettable Voice
angles.copy: The show must go on. Today, we celebrate the unparalleled talent and stage presence of Freddie Mercury.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' is 61 today. What's your top track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this solemn day, we remember the tragic loss of John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: A voice for peace, a musical genius. Today, we honour the life and enduring spirit of John Lennon.
